item.title: Writing Lisp is AI resistant and I'm sad
item.description:
📝 So, I created a tool called tmux-repl-mcp that would make interacting with the REPL more straightforward. The difference in writing Python and Lisp with AI was of course dramatic, downright wild. There are reasons other than a lack of training data that makes lisp particularly AI resistant.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.djhaskin.com/blog/writing-lisp-is-ai-resistant-and-im-sad/
